Package qupath.ext.omero.core.pixelapis

Interface PixelApi

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
All Known Implementing Classes:
IceApi, MsPixelBufferApi, WebApi
public interface PixelApi extends AutoCloseable
This interface provides information (e.g. types of image supported) on a specific API to access pixel values of an OMERO image. It can also be used to create a PixelApiReader corresponding to this API.

A PixelApi must be closed once no longer used.

    • createReader

      PixelApiReader createReader(long imageId, qupath.lib.images.servers.ImageServerMetadata metadata, List<String> args) throws ExecutionException, InterruptedException
      Creates a PixelApiReader corresponding to this API that will be used to read pixel values of an image. This may take a few seconds depending on the implementation.

      Note that you should close the returned reader when it's no longer used. As a precaution, this pixel API will (if needed) close them when it itself is closed, but it's better if they are closed as soon as possible.

      Note that if this API is not available (see isAvailable()), calling this function will result in undefined behavior.

      Parameters:
      imageId - the ID of the image to open
      metadata - the metadata of the image to open
      args - additional arguments to change the reader creation. See the description of the pixel API implementation for more details
      Returns:
      a new reader corresponding to this API
      Throws:
      ExecutionException - if an error occurred while creating the reader
      InterruptedException - if the calling thread is interrupted while creating the reader
      IllegalArgumentException - when the provided image cannot be read by this API (see canReadImage(PixelType, int))
